## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the subject (nominative) form of a [`gmeow:PronounSet`](../classes/gmeow-PronounSet.md) — one of the five forms that define a custom set.

### Avoid when

- Avoid filling only some of the five forms on a specifying set (subject, object, possessive determiner, possessive pronoun, reflexive should all be present) and avoid it on a non-specifying stance (any / ask / name-only).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:pronounSubject`](gmeow-pronounSubject.md) once per [`gmeow:PronounSet`](../classes/gmeow-PronounSet.md) (functional), alongside the other four form properties when minting a custom set.

### Examples

- ex:set [`gmeow:pronounSubject`](gmeow-pronounSubject.md) "they".
